title: Study Abroad and Academic Life
summary: Study situations, academic communication, and formal requests.
whyItMatters: Academic mobility requires learners to understand institutions, deadlines, course organization, accommodation, and the formal communication used to solve administrative problems.

mentalModel.title: Map the academic journey
mentalModel.content: Organize language around application, enrollment, course participation, assessment, and completion.

mentalModel.title: Separate academic and practical support
mentalModel.content: Identify whether a question belongs to teaching staff, the international office, housing services, or administration.

ruleBlocks.title: Name academic roles and offices
ruleBlocks.content: Use Hochschule, Fakultät, Sekretariat, Prüfungsamt, Dozent, and international office precisely.

ruleBlocks.title: Track documents and deadlines
ruleBlocks.content: Connect application forms, proof, enrollment, registration, recognition, and submission dates.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe course participation
ruleBlocks.content: Use Seminar besuchen, Referat halten, Prüfung ablegen, Leistung erbringen, and credits erwerben.

ruleBlocks.title: State the problem and requested outcome
ruleBlocks.content: Explain the relevant status, deadline, missing information, and exact help needed.

sentenceStructure: Give identifying course or application details early.
Use exact dates and document names.
Distinguish completed actions from requested next steps.

comparisons.summary: Academic rules and delays provide contexts for genitive relationships and prepositions.
The communication lesson turns these situations into clear institutional emails.

examples.de: Für die Bewerbung muss ich einen Sprachnachweis einreichen.
examples.en: I must submit proof of language proficiency for the application.

examples.de: Das Seminar ist bereits voll, deshalb stehe ich auf der Warteliste.
examples.en: The seminar is already full, so I am on the waiting list.

examples.de: Das Prüfungsamt entscheidet über die Anerkennung der Leistungen.
examples.en: The examinations office decides on recognition of the credits.

examples.de: Das International Office hilft bei Fragen zur Unterkunft.
examples.en: The international office helps with accommodation questions.

examples.de: Wegen einer technischen Störung konnte ich die Frist nicht einhalten.
examples.en: Because of a technical problem, I could not meet the deadline.

commonMistakes.wrong: Send every question to the lecturer.
commonMistakes.correct: Identify the responsible office before writing.
commonMistakes.reason: Academic responsibilities are divided among roles.

commonMistakes.wrong: Ich habe ein Problem mit meinem Studium.
commonMistakes.correct: Name the course, document, deadline, and requested action.
commonMistakes.reason: Specific information enables a useful response.

commonMistakes.wrong: Mention a missed deadline without proposing the next step.
commonMistakes.correct: Explain briefly and ask whether late submission is possible.
commonMistakes.reason: Formal problem-solving needs a clear request.

tips: Build a personal glossary from actual university forms.
Keep application numbers and course codes available.
Create a deadline checklist with responsible contacts.
